content.comment_body: If there are no indicators for the inputs or outputs, is it possible to monitor the program after installation while the system is operational?
The module I'm referring to is the [product_name] with model [article_no].

Hi, Real-time online monitoring within the system isn't available to track current activity. The [product_name] editor software provides a simulation feature for testing programs. If a malfunction occurs, the simulator can help identify and solve the issue.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report challenges in monitoring the operation of the [product_name], specifically model [article_no], after installation due to the absence of LED indicators for inputs and outputs. The system does not support online real-time monitoring during operation—only offline testing through the editor's simulation is available. This limits transparency and makes live maintenance difficult.
analysis.user_expectations: Users would like to monitor system status and program execution in real time following installation, preferably with direct feedback or diagnostic features.
